name: host_inventory
title: Host Inventory
prompt:
Use the tools to inspect the provided host/repo snapshot. The snapshot is exposed as an emulated filesystem, not the live host filesystem. There is no submit tool. When ready, answer directly and stop.

What machine am I on? Cover OS, CPU/GPU, memory, disks, available runtimes, and anything that would matter for running local models or benchmarks. Be factual; say when something is unavailable or unknown.
